# Where the old DMGs went (BUILD-22, 2026-08-26)

`ALL-Translation-Tool-0.12.0.dmg` and `ALL-Translation-Tool-1.0.0-rc.1.dmg`
(the old app name; the second shared a version string with the current
image while differing in content) were moved to
`/Volumes/Oct2024(8TB)/ALL-superseded-DMGs/`.

They predate the 2026-08-26 payload strips, so they still carry the
raw THL records and the book texts internally — fine as in-house
archives, not for distribution. The current image is the only one
that should ever leave this machine.
